dossier.public_summary: The transit depths alternate odd and even and individual depths scatter more than expected for a planet, with a significant brightness swing at the same period as strong starspot changes. That matches a binary eclipsing system seen at twice the blind-search period rather than a planet on target.

reasons.why: Odd even depth difference is large and significant, points to two different eclipses at twice the reported period, classic binary at period_x2 27.8 d.
Individual transit depths are not consistent with a single planet; signal is carried by a few events and depths vary by ~19% between sectors, inconsistent with a planet on target.
